items.description:
A high gold dome worked all over with a fine frosted texture.

Metal: solid 10K, 14K or 18K gold in yellow, white or rose. White gold is unplated, a soft silvery grey.
Size: the dome is about 9 mm across and stands 3.4 mm above the finger.

Each piece is made to order and ships free within the United States. Add a gift message at checkout and it ships with the piece.

Care: solid gold does not tarnish. Take it off before the gym, the pool and the shower, and wipe it with a soft cloth.

The product images are design visualizations of the finished piece, and the three metal image is a colour visualization of the same design in yellow, white and rose gold; the handmade piece may vary slightly.

items.description:
A full circle of overlapping gold leaves, a wreath worn on the finger.

Overlapping leaves run the whole way round with no plain section at the back, each one lapping the last in the same direction. The leaves run the whole way round with no plain section at the back, each one overlapping the last in the same direction so the ring turns like a wreath hung on a door. It is the only piece in the line with no beginning and no end.

Metal: solid 10K, 14K or 18K gold in yellow, white or rose. White gold is unplated, a soft silvery grey.
Size: the leaf band is about 2.4 mm wide the whole way round.

Each piece is made to order and ships free within the United States. Add a gift message at checkout and it ships with the piece.

Care: solid gold does not tarnish. Take it off before the gym, the pool and the shower, and wipe it with a soft cloth.

The product images are design visualizations of the finished piece, and the three metal image is a colour visualization of the same design in yellow, white and rose gold; the handmade piece may vary slightly.
